The first Super Artemis release: Artemis with microphone streaming, custom in-stream menus and quick-action bars, multi-finger gestures, smarter sessions, encrypted backups, and a batch of proven fixes from upstream Moonlight, Artemis and community forks.

**Install:** `SuperArtemis-v1.0.0-arm64-v8a.apk` installs as `com.mohitarora.superartemis`, side by side with Artemis and Moonlight. Pair with Apollo once, because each app maintains its own pairing identity. Automatic update tracking is supported through [Obtainium](https://github.com/Arora-Sir/Super-Artemis#super-artemis).

## What's new

### Voice
- Microphone streaming to Apollo (`stream_mic = enabled` on the host).
- "Microphone at stream start": always off (default), always on or follow last state, remembered per PC.
- Mute and unmute from the Quick Menu, quick-action bars, or multi-finger gestures. Muting stops the microphone hardware and Opus encoder, turning off the Android privacy indicator and saving battery.

### Menus and in-stream controls
- Sectioned Quick Menu with Actions, Session (Disconnect and Quit highlighted in red), and Menu categories.
- Menu style editor with List, Grid with icons, and Compact styles picked next to a live preview.
- Hide unused actions from the Advanced Menu while keeping Quick Menu entries clean.
- Floating menu button that opens the Quick Menu even when Back Menu is disabled.
- Open Settings directly from an active stream. Closing Settings reconnects to the stream immediately so changes take effect without manual restarts.
- Quick-action bars: place small action buttons and keys anywhere on screen across 9 anchor points with fine nudge controls. Supports named bar sets (e.g. desktop and gaming) switchable from the Quick Menu.
- Automatic line wrapping on quick-action bars so buttons fit the screen without running off.

### Keys, flows and keyboard
- Special keys without JSON editing: reorder, hide, re-icon, or reset built-in keys, or record custom keys on the built-in keyboard or physical keyboard with names and 235 searchable icons.
- Special keys as step flows: combine shortcuts, Unicode text in any language, delays, holds, and repeats into a single button.
- More keys library: 24 everyday Windows shortcuts (Select All, Copy, Cut, Undo, Redo, Save, Task Manager, Clipboard history, and more).
- F13 to F24 virtual keys for PC hotkeys and macro pads.
- Phone hotkeys: press combinations such as Ctrl + Alt + 1 on a phone keyboard to trigger client actions or flows without interrupting the stream.
- Releasing held keys when the virtual keyboard closes, preventing latched modifier keys.
- Sectioned key recorder layout tailored for portrait phones, with full PC layout on landscape and tablets.

### Multi-finger gestures
- Configurable 3, 4, and 5-finger taps, double taps, holds, and 3 and 4-finger directional swipes across all touch modes (including Pan and Zoom).
- Windows touchpad swipes preset (Task View, show desktop, switch apps and desktops) in one tap.
- Middle mouse click as an assignable gesture action.
- Master gesture toggle on the settings row to pass raw multi-touch straight to the host when preferred.

### Sessions and connectivity
- Leave policy options: Disconnect, Keep in Recents and resume when reopened within 30 minutes, or Picture-in-picture across any app switch (including Samsung One Hand Operation+).
- Optional "Connect to the last PC on app start".
- One-tap Reconnect button on connection drop dialogs and after closing picture-in-picture.
- Network drop grace period (10 to 60 seconds) so transient Wi-Fi interruptions keep sessions alive.
- Landscape orientation control: sensor, normal, or reverse landscape for stands and docks.
- System key capture accessibility service for forwarding Alt+Tab and Windows key, with generic feedback to avoid screen reader conflicts.

### Backup, look and settings
- Encrypted single-file backups (`.sabackup`) using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, carrying all settings, layouts, and profiles. Selective restore previews imported items and warns about hardware settings the target device cannot run.
- Material You dynamic styling as default on Android 12+, with Wallpaper theming and 8 curated color schemes.
- Pure black mode for OLED displays, with a 10-level Surface Lift slider to dial card contrast from flat to elevated.
- Quick setups (Competitive play, Everyday desktop, Best picture, Battery saver) that stage tuned configurations with one-tap restore profiles.
- Settings search bar that remains pinned to top, matches everyday keywords and synonyms, and expands collapsed groups automatically. Tablets feature a side-by-side section navigation rail.
- In-app Support development card with UPI QR code and PayPal, plus developer profile links and in-app credits.

## Fixes from upstream and community forks
- Frame pacing restored, render loop drain eliminated, and refresh rate tracking across refresh rate changes.
- Forced surface frame rate and fixed surface size that caused stutter are removed.
- Decoder setup hang loop prevented on NVIDIA and MediaTek decoders, audio effects detached from PC audio setting, and pairing private key excluded from cloud backups.
- Joy-Con fix setting restored.
- 4K streams maintain the active display mode without unnecessary switches.
- Print Screen key and Samsung keyboard cover screenshot key forwarding.
- Vendor keyboards with out-of-range key codes no longer crash stream start.
- Stylus (S Pen) stroke isolation from handwriting keyboard on Android 13+.
- Adding PC from `art://` pairing links on high latency networks.
- Controller LED crashes, rumble on recent Android versions, Xbox Series controller IDs, Shift key behavior, and Android 15 and 16 key codes.
- Native core: recovery after multi-block video loss and dropped IDR frames, thread and pthread attribute leak fixes, RTT queries without lock contention, and RTSP response hardening.
